code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        color, count = Counter(row).most_common(1)[0]
        if count / w >= 0.82:

    line_color = Counter(c for _, c in row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]

    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) / h >= 0.65]
    fill_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(cols) - 1):
            a = [grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri]][cols[ci+1]],
                 grid[rows[ri+1]][cols[ci]], grid[rows[ri+1]][cols[ci+1]]]

    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marked), max(r for r, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marked), max(c for _, c in marked)
